程序包 org.bukkit.inventory.view

接口 BeaconView

所有超级接口:
InventoryView
public interface BeaconView extends InventoryView
一个提供与信标视图数据相关额外方法的 InventoryView 实例。

原文： An instance of InventoryView which provides extra methods related to beacon view data.

    • getTier

      int getTier()
      获取信标的等级。

      信标等级由其所在金字塔的高度推断得出。除非信标被激活，否则其等级为0。

      原文： Gets the tier of the beacon

      Beacon tier is deduced by the height of the pyramid the beacon is standing on. The level of the beacon is 0 unless the beacon is activated.

      返回:
      信标的等级

      原文：Gets the tier of the beacon

      Beacon tier is deduced by the height of the pyramid the beacon is standing on. The level of the beacon is 0 unless the beacon is activated.

      原文：The tier of the beacon

    • getPrimaryEffect

      @Nullable @Nullable PotionEffectType getPrimaryEffect()
      获取信标的主要效果。

      如果信标等级足够高，主要效果可以升级到二级，例如速度II。此时 getSecondaryEffect() 不会返回null，而是返回与本方法相同的 PotionEffectType。

      原文： Gets the primary effect of the beacon.

      If the beacon level is high enough where the primary effect can be upgraded to level two, e.g. Speed 2. Instead of getSecondaryEffect() being null it getSecondaryEffect() returns the same PotionEffectType as this method.

      返回:
      信标上启用的主要效果

      原文：Gets the primary effect of the beacon.

      If the beacon level is high enough where the primary effect can be upgraded to level two, e.g. Speed 2. Instead of getSecondaryEffect() being null it getSecondaryEffect() returns the same PotionEffectType as this method.

      原文：The primary effect enabled on the beacon

    • getSecondaryEffect

      @Nullable @Nullable PotionEffectType getSecondaryEffect()
      获取信标的次要效果。

      如果信标等级足够高，主要效果可以升级到二级，例如速度II。次要效果将返回与 getPrimaryEffect() 相同的效果。

      原文： Gets the secondary effect of the beacon.

      If the beacon level is high enough where the primary effect can be upgraded to level two, e.g. Speed 2. The secondary effect will return the same effect as getPrimaryEffect().

      返回:
      信标上启用的次要效果

      原文：Gets the secondary effect of the beacon.

      If the beacon level is high enough where the primary effect can be upgraded to level two, e.g. Speed 2. The secondary effect will return the same effect as getPrimaryEffect().

      原文：The secondary effect enabled on the beacon

    • setPrimaryEffect

      void setPrimaryEffect(@Nullable @Nullable PotionEffectType effect)
      设置信标的主要效果，或传入null以清除。

      提供的 PotionEffectType 必须是信标中已存在的有效选项之一。

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION

      原文： Sets the primary effect of the beacon, or null to clear

      The PotionEffectType provided must be one that is already within the beacon as a valid option.

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION
      参数:
      effect - 期望的主要效果

      原文：Sets the primary effect of the beacon, or null to clear

      The PotionEffectType provided must be one that is already within the beacon as a valid option.

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION

      原文：desired primary effect

    • setSecondaryEffect

      void setSecondaryEffect(@Nullable @Nullable PotionEffectType effect)
      设置信标的次要效果，或传入null以清除。注意，等级必须大于等于4且已设置主要效果，此效果才会激活。

      提供的 PotionEffectType 必须是信标中已存在的有效选项之一。

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION

      原文： Sets the secondary effect on this beacon, or null to clear. Note that tier must be >= 4 and a primary effect must be set in order for this effect to be active.

      The PotionEffectType provided must be one that is already within the beacon as a valid option.

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION
      参数:
      effect - 期望的次要效果

      原文：Sets the secondary effect on this beacon, or null to clear. Note that tier must be >= 4 and a primary effect must be set in order for this effect to be active.

      The PotionEffectType provided must be one that is already within the beacon as a valid option.

      1. PotionEffectType.SPEED
      2. PotionEffectType.HASTE
      3. PotionEffectType.RESISTANCE
      4. PotionEffectType.JUMP_BOOST
      5. PotionEffectType.STRENGTH
      6. PotionEffectType.REGENERATION

      原文：the desired secondary effect
